investigation_notes.Playbook Used: Azure Network Security Group Modification Triage
investigation_notes.Description: Azure Network Security Group modification detected for NSG nsg-prod-db-cluster in resource group rg-baltic-prod-data. The change was initiated by aleksei.ivanov@globalcorp.ee (Owner) from IP 82.102.15.144 in Tallinn, Estonia, and appears to be a write operation modifying security rules. The request_body includes an inbound rule Allow_LB_HealthCheck_Internal for 10.0.5.2:443 with source '*' which could broaden exposure beyond normal health-check needs. Given the production scope, ownership level, off-hours timing, and the potential for unnecessary broad access, this activity is classified as High Priority and warrants immediate validation.
